faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do you take a fee when I hire someone?
faq.a1: No. You pay the membership and nothing else. We never take a share of a salary or a placement fee.
faq.a2: Never. We remind you before it ends, and renewal is always your choice.
faq.q3: I have several campuses. How does it work?
faq.a3: Each campus is NT$10,000 for its own 12 months. A campus you add later costs the same and gets its own full 12 months.
faq.q4: Can I look around before paying?
faq.a4: No. Educators agreed to share their profiles only with paying members. We show a sample profile so you know what to expect.
faq.a5: No. We do not run background checks on educators, schools or families. We are a connection website, so please complete all checks yourself.
